name: Kinetic Assault
description: Through manipulation of latent energy present all around you, you create powerful blasts and forceful blows that can prove devastating to your opponents. As you manipulate this energy, you will accumulate Impulse. Each stack of Impulse grants you a scaling recharge buff. Impulse is also used to empower Disrupting Torrent, Kinetic Shockwave, Energetic Strike and Mass Driver.

powers.name: Kinetic Bolt
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into a small bolt of kinetic energy that you launch at a single target. This bolt causes light smashing and energy damage on impact and reduces their recharge rate and movement speed slightly. The force of the impact can cause the target to suffer additional lethal damage over time.  Kinetic Bolt awards 1 stack of Impulse.  Damage: Light, Recharge: Very Fast
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, Light DMG (Smashing/Energy), Foe Minor DoT(Lethal), -Speed, -Recharge, Self +Impulse

powers.name: Forceful Blow
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into a small surge of energy that empowers your fists to deliver a crushing punch to the body of your target. This blow causes high smashing and energy damage on impact, reduces the target's damage output and has a  chance to knock your target into the air.  Forceful Blow awards 2 stacks of Impulse.  Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate
powers.shortHelp: Melee, High DMG (Smashing/Energy), Foe Knockup, -DMG, Self +Impulse

powers.name: Crushing Blast
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into a concentrated blast of surging energy aimed at a single target. This causes high smashing and energy damage on contact and reduces the target's movement and recharge speed slightly. The force of the impact can cause some lethal damage over time.  Crushing Blast awards 1 stack of Impulse.  Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, High DMG (Smashing/Energy), Foe Minor DoT (Lethal), -Speed, -Recharge, Self +Impulse

powers.name: Disrupting Torrent
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into a cone of surging energy that crashes into the foes in front of you. This torrent causes moderate smashing and energy damage on impact, and has a chance to knock affected targets down. Affected targets will also have their regeneration rate reduced slightly.  Disrupting Torrent consumes all stacks of Impulse and its knockdown chance, damage and regeneration debuff scale with the number of consumed stacks.  If used when you have 5 stacks of Impulse, this power has a chance to immediately refresh Coalescence.  Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Slow
powers.shortHelp: Ranged (Cone), Moderate DMG (Smashing/Energy), Foe Knockdown, -Regen, Self -Impulse

powers.name: Coalescence
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into surge of power that increases your damage potential and chance to hit moderately for a short time.  Recharge: Very Long

powers.name: Kinetic Shockwave
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into shockwave that erupts from your body and strikes nearby enemies. This shockwave causes moderate smashing and energy damage on impact and reduces the damage of affected foes. The force of the impact may knock affected targets down. Kinetic Shockwave consumes all stacks of Impulse and its knockdown chance and damage scale with the number of consumed stacks.  If used when you have 5 stacks of Impulse, this power has a chance to stun nearby foes and has a chance to also immediately refresh Coalescence.  Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Long
powers.shortHelp: PBAoE, Moderate DMG (Smashing), Foe Knockdown, -DMG, Self -Impulse

powers.name: Energetic Strike
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into a massive surge of force that empowers your fists to deliver a devastating blow to a single target. This blow causes extreme smashing and energy damage on impact and will reduce the target's damage.  The force from this power's impact is so great that it is likely to disorient most foes. Energetic Strike consumes all stacks of Impulse and its damage debuff and damage scale with the number of consumed stacks.  If used when you have 5 stacks of Impulse, this power's stun effect will last long and Energetic Strike has a chance to immediately refresh Coalescence.  Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Long
powers.shortHelp: Melee, Extreme DMG (Smashing/Energy), Foe Disorient, -DMG, Self -Impulse

powers.name: Kinetic Lance
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into a lance of energy that you fire at a single target. This lance pierces the target, causing an initial burst of extreme energy and lethal damage that then causes a minor amount of damage over time.  Affected foes will also have their movement speed and recharge rate reduced for a short time.  Kinetic Lance awards 3 stacks of Impulse if the interruptible version is used, if instant-cast this power will award 2 stacks of Impulse.  This is a sniper attack, and is best fired from a distance, as it can be interrupted. If you have more than 97% To-Hit, this attack becomes instant-cast.  Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Very Slow
powers.shortHelp: Sniper, Extreme DMG (Energy/Lethal), Foe Minor DoT (Lethal), -Speed, -Recharge, Self +Impulse

powers.name: Mass Driver
powers.description: You form the potential energies around you into a concentrated mass aimed at a single target. This causes superior smashing and energy damage on impact and reduces the target's movement and recharge speed. The force of the impact causes light lethal damage over time.  If you have less than 5 stacks of Impulse, Mass Driver will award 2 Impulse.  If you have 5 stacks of Impulse this power will deal additional damage and reduce the target's smashing, lethal and energy resistance moderately for a short time and this power will also have a small chance to recharge Coalescence.  Damage: Superior, Recharge: Slow
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, Superior DMG (Smashing/Energy), Foe Light DoT (Lethal), -Speed, -Recharge, Self +/- Impulse
